findings.evidence: Lines 196, 209, 214, 228 each list `multiplets` as a simp-set entry; grep for `multiplets` elsewhere in the file finds only the definition at line 159 and those four unfoldings.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem multiplets_eq : a.multiplets = [a.quarkDoublet, a.upSinglet, a.downSinglet, a.leptonDoublet, a.electronSinglet] := (rfl)` and drop `multiplets` from the four simp-only lists.
findings.issue: `multiplets` is public with no lemma at all: there is no `multiplets_eq`/`mem_multiplets_iff`, so nothing has `a.multiplets` as an LHS. Every proof reaches the list by naming the definition in a `simp only` list, i.e. by unfolding the exposed body.

findings.evidence: Line 395 closes `isAnomalyFree_iff_smaccs` with `rw [accGrav_toSMCharges, ..., IsAnomalyFree]` — the definition name itself is the rewrite, i.e. delta-unfolding the body; no lemma states this equivalence.
findings.fix: Add `theorem isAnomalyFree_def : a.IsAnomalyFree ↔ a.gravitationalAnomaly = 0 ∧ a.su2Anomaly = 0 ∧ a.su3Anomaly = 0 ∧ a.cubicAnomaly = 0 := (Iff.rfl)` and use it in place of `rw [..., IsAnomalyFree]`.
findings.issue: `IsAnomalyFree` has no coefficient-level restatement. `isAnomalyFree_iff` (239) jumps straight to the expanded hypercharge polynomials, so a consumer holding `a.gravitationalAnomaly = 0 ∧ a.su2Anomaly = 0 ∧ a.su3Anomaly = 0 ∧ a.cubicAnomaly = 0` has only defeq to get `a.IsAnomalyFree`.

summary: All three prior findings are fixed (MulAction instance, @[simps] on the six structure-valued defs, Chirality.sign lemmas), and the accCube simpNF contest is accepted. Two public definitions, `multiplets` and `IsAnomalyFree`, still carry no characteristic lemma, so every use goes through unfolding the exposed body.
